+

+    p = dict(zip(obs.meta['proprio']['layout'], obs.meta['proprio']['now']))
+    return np.array([p['cmd_' + key] for key in Robot().spec()['action_types']['ee_pose']['layout']], dtype=float)

+             'left_x left_y left_z left_rx left_ry left_rz '
+             'right_little right_ring right_middle right_index right_thumb_flexion right_thumb_rotation '
+             'left_little left_ring left_middle left_index left_thumb_flexion left_thumb_rotation').split()
+    return np.array([p['cmd_' + name] for name in names], dtype=float)
+
+
+def main():
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument('--stage', required=True)
+    ap.add_argument('--hand', choices=['left', 'right'])
+    ap.add_argument('--world', type=float, nargs=3)
+    ap.add_argument('--rotation', type=float, nargs=3)
+    ap.add_argument('--fingers', type=float, nargs=6)
+    ap.add_argument('--seconds', type=float, default=2.0)
+    ap.add_argument('--observe', action='store_true')
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    r = Robot()
+    before = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMS, include_depth=True, video='none')
+    start = get_command(before)
+    target = start.copy()
+    if args.hand:
+        i = 0 if args.hand == 'right' else 6
+        j = 12 if args.hand == 'right' else 18
+        if args.world:
